answer: Fingerprint the quartz, not the key. Each machine's crystal clock drifts at its own rate, and the server can read that drift by comparing an agent's signed timestamps with its own receive times over weeks, a relic of 2005 research on remote device fingerprinting. Identities whose drift lines match share one reward slot until audited, one oyster, one pearl. Evasion: synthesize a distinct, steady fake drift per identity, which takes care. Wrongly hit: honest tenants on one cloud host; shared hardware isn't shared ownership, so a match pools pay, never slashes.
